rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q001.objective: Match each problem with its corrective action.
rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q001.stem: Actions: A return/exchange; B investigate abnormal fridge temperature and adjust settings/request repair; C clean again and sanitize/disinfect as appropriate; D no food-handling work; E repeat correct handwashing. Match, in order: damaged packaging, abnormal fridge temperature, dirty utensils, dirty toilet, digestive symptoms, insufficient handwashing.
rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q001.explanation: Receiving defects require return/exchange; temperature abnormalities require checking cause and equipment. Clean and sanitize/disinfect utensils or toilets appropriately; stop food work for digestive symptoms and repeat inadequate handwashing. Heating does not automatically rescue every temperature-abused food.

rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q002.objective: Link date, check item, problem and action in the record.
rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q002.stem: R = receiving; W = handwashing; × = a recorded failure. On 5/8 (8 May), damaged packaging was found and exchanged. On 5/9 (9 May), missed handwashing after the toilet was found and repeated correctly. Which record links dates and items without hiding failures?
options: Mark all items good on both days, without notes
Combine them in next month’s unchecked cells
rst31-v2-r4-hyg-q002.explanation: Record the actual date and item, with the observed problem and action in notes. Exchange or repeated washing does not erase the failure found. Never prefill unchecked dates.
reasons: Do not omit a discovered problem after correction.
Use the actual date/item; do not fill unchecked cells.
